title: Diagnostically Meaningful, Privacy-aware Synthetic Chest CT via Class-Conditional Latent Sampling in Diffusion Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.33234v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large, well-annotated datasets are essential for developing medical artificial intelligence models, yet data sharing is often restricted by privacy regulations. Synthetic images may help address this limitation if they preserve diagnostic information while reducing the risk of reproducing patient data. We developed a diffusion autoencoder-based framework for class-conditional synthetic chest CT generation that incorporates latent-space distance filtering to reduce the likelihood of regenerating training samples.   A diffusion autoencoder was trained on the public RSNA 2020 Pulmonary Embolism (PE) dataset. PE-positive and PE-negative images were synthesized by sampling latent representations from class-specific kernel density estimates. Samples with a nearest-neighbor latent-space distance below a predefined threshold were rejected. translated_title: 基于扩散自编码器中类别条件潜在采样的具有诊断意义且注重隐私保护的合成胸部CT
translated_abstract: 大型且标注完善的数据集对于开发医疗人工智能模型至关重要，然而数据共享往往受到隐私法规的限制。如果合成图像能够在保留诊断信息的同时降低复现患者数据的风险，可能有助于解决这一局限。我们开发了一种基于扩散自编码器的类别条件合成胸部CT生成框架，该框架引入了潜在空间距离过滤机制，以降低重新生成训练样本的可能性。该扩散自编码器在公开的RSNA 2020肺栓塞（PE）数据集上进行了训练。通过从类别特定的核密度估计中采样潜在表示，合成PE阳性和PE阴性图像，并拒绝最近邻潜在空间距离低于预设阈值的样本。为评估诊断效用，研究者在10次独立运行中使用真实与合成数据训练了ResNet-50分类器。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散自编码器的隐私感知胸部CT合成框架，通过类别条件潜在采样与潜在空间距离过滤，生成具有诊断价值且能降低复现患者数据风险的合成图像。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a privacy-aware diffusion autoencoder framework for generating diagnostically meaningful synthetic chest CT images, combining class-conditional latent sampling with latent-space distance filtering to reduce the risk of reproducing patient data.
